# ElevenLabs — ElevenLabs Grants

Scale plan for 12 months with 33,000,000 characters, which the page describes as over 680 hours of Agents usage and more than $5,500+ in value. Converts to the Free plan at the end of the term.

## What you get

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | usage allowance |
| **Maximum** | $5,500 — see the vendor's exact wording below |
| **Duration** | 12 months |
| **Expiry** | Ends at 12 months or when the allocated characters are used, whichever comes first. |
| **When it ends** | After your grant period is over or once you have 10,000 credits left, your plan will automatically convert to a Free plan, unless you have selected otherwise. |


### Not covered

- Agencies or consulting firms
- Existing enterprise customers
- Short-term or one-off projects
- Projects built for children aged 18 or under
- Applicants without a business or monetization strategy

> **Stacking:** One application per company.
